title: Security Logging Validation
summary: Structured security logging is now active for all security-relevant events including failed logins, unauthorized access, upload validation failures, and system exceptions.

hookRegistrations: registerSecurityLogging(app) — registers onResponse and onError hooks

loggedEvents.trigger: API request without valid authentication (401 response)
Authenticated user attempted to access route above their role (403 response)
Request with malformed or tampered JWT
CSRF token or origin validation failure
File upload rejected (wrong type, too large, etc.)
File contains suspicious patterns (scripts, exec calls, etc.)
Unhandled server error (500+ response) or onError hook

severityLevels.INFO: Normal operations (logins, token refreshes, authenticated access)
severityLevels.WARNING: Potential issues (failed logins, unauthorized access, rate limits)
severityLevels.ERROR: Security concerns (CSRF failures, origin validation, system errors)
severityLevels.CRITICAL: Immediate attention needed (malicious files, data breaches)

adminEndpoints.description: Query security logs with filters (severity, event, userId, since, limit)
Aggregated security summary (event counts, severity breakdown, recent critical/errors)

storage.autoTrim: Trims to 45000 entries when limit reached
storage.productionRecommendation: Stream to external log aggregator (ELK Stack, Datadog, CloudWatch)

responseTimeTracking.description: Each request start time is recorded; response time calculated in onResponse hook

productionRecommendations: Stream security logs to ELK Stack or CloudWatch for persistence and alerting
Set up alerts for CRITICAL events (malicious files, repeated failed logins)
Implement IP-based anomaly detection (unusual access patterns)
Add geographic analysis of access patterns (flag access from unexpected locations)
Configure log rotation and retention policies (90 days minimum for compliance)
Integrate with SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) system
